THE PAPER BOAT

CHAPTER ONE

Mara folded the letter into a boat, because there was no one left to send it to.
The gutter ran fast after the storm, and the boat went with it.

* * *

At the corner it caught on a grate, spun twice, and slipped through.

CHAPTER TWO: Downstream

Under the street the water was loud and certain. The boat did not sink.
Somewhere ahead there was light.

Epilogue

Years later a fisherman found a paper boat in a net, perfectly dry, and kept it on his windowsill.
